name: PROTOCOL AI CQB
scope: Both readable SQF files fully reviewed: fn_cqb.sqf and XEH_preInit.sqf. Binary config/startup binding, exact dependencies and licence remain unverified. No raw source copied into product.

behaviourDispositions.intent: Use nearby interior positions during urban contact.
behaviourDispositions.cbe: BuildingContactSelect/IndoorActorDispatch use known contact/position clues; explicit CortexGarrison and CortexClearBuilding remain distinct behaviour tasks.
behaviourDispositions.departure: No allUnits enemy-presence oracle or automatic capture of every building near leader. Source clears first building with positions, which can differ from enemy-trigger building. CBE keeps target identity/transform.

behaviourDispositions.source: Select nearest buildingExit and door trigger, open/close door
behaviourDispositions.intent: Reach a real entrance and interact with nearby doors.
behaviourDispositions.cbe: CortexBuildingDoor and building FSM entry routing, actual actor proximity, locked-door/ownership guards.
behaviourDispositions.departure: Source arrival wait is commented out; door interaction can occur remotely before entry. Do not copy fixed20door/51exit loops or prematurely close a door on followers.

behaviourDispositions.intent: Prepare a hostile interior before exposing assaulters.
behaviourDispositions.cbe: Existing finite tactical fragmentation has inventory/projectile/ROE/ownership safety; room geometry-specific door grenade execution is not established by that general feature.
behaviourDispositions.departure: Reject adding HandGrenade to inventory, forced fire without a safety solution and immediate retreat with no verified projectile.

behaviourDispositions.source: Sequential building positions and whole-group doMove
behaviourDispositions.intent: Continue through the interior rather than occupy a single point.
behaviourDispositions.cbe: BuildingOperationStep finite pair routes and confirmed visits, bounded unreachable-node handling; IndoorActorOperation search-memory visits up to4nodes under original deadline.
behaviourDispositions.departure: Source sends every alive member to same room point, advances after15s timeout and sprays suppression nearby. CBE does not count timeout as arrival/room safety.

behaviourDispositions.source: Distribute units by building position modulo count
behaviourDispositions.intent: Use building cover and observation positions.
behaviourDispositions.cbe: Explicit Garrison assignments, source-aware native paths, optional operator teleport and scoped post/duck handling.
behaviourDispositions.departure: Reject second random offset doMove overriding the first interior destination, permanent NoVoice and unleased speed/stance resets.

behaviourDispositions.cbe: CBA owns configuration, Zeus/ZEN owns tasks. Existing behaviour-specific gates and task parameters are retained.
behaviourDispositions.departure: No duplicate source-branded settings. Source radius setting gates activation while internal query/distance still hardcodes30m. Cosmetic voice suppression is not a tactical requirement.

costAndOwnershipDefects: Endless allGroups loop without delay, perbuilding allUnits scan and nested spawned room workers.
No group/actor locality, Zeus/native/specialist ownership or newer-order cancellation contract.
CQBClearing can remain set on early target-building failure; DefendCQB and Location markers persist without lifecycle cleanup.
concreteCbeFix: Garrison initial and recurring approach guards plus event/delayed duck handlers now yield to simulation dormancy, hidden actors and queued treatment. Assignment identity/timing retained; no medical queue mutation; release PATH cleanup left intact.
remaining: Physical entry/flow/repeated use, actual safe fragmentation at a doorway, garrison handback and performance remain unverified. No broad source parity or acceptance claim.
